title: AZ-900 · Describe features and tools in Azure for governance and compliance · Describe the purpose of Azure Policy

questions.category: Describe Azure Management and Governance > Describe features and tools in Azure for governance and compliance
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe the purpose of Azure Policy
questions.question: Which statement best describes Azure Policy?

options.text: A view that helps organizations understand where data is stored and how it is classified
A service for creating, assigning, and managing rules that audit or control Azure resource configurations
A lock that permits authorized users to read and modify a resource but prevents deletion
The Service Trust Portal landing area for browsing available documents

questions.explanation: Azure Policy is a service for creating, assigning, and managing rules that audit or control Azure resource configurations.

questions.category: Describe Azure Management and Governance > Describe features and tools in Azure for governance and compliance
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe the purpose of Azure Policy
questions.question: In the context of this Microsoft Learn unit, what does Policy definition refer to?

options.text: A service for creating, assigning, and managing rules that audit or control Azure resource configurations
A resource-group or subscription lock applying to resources beneath that scope
An individual Azure Policy rule that describes a desired or prohibited resource condition
A Service Trust Portal area for pinning documents and optionally receiving update notifications

questions.explanation: Policy definition is an individual Azure Policy rule that describes a desired or prohibited resource condition.

questions.category: Describe Azure Management and Governance > Describe features and tools in Azure for governance and compliance

The behavior by which a policy assigned at a higher scope applies to resources in child scopes

questions.question: What is the primary meaning of Compliance evaluation in Azure fundamentals?

options.text: A Purview capability for understanding how data moves and transforms across systems
Azure Policy checking existing resources and identifying those that do not meet assigned rules

The required first step before performing an operation that the lock blocks

questions.category: Describe Azure Management and Governance > Describe features and tools in Azure for governance and compliance
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe the purpose of Azure Policy
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Initiative: a Purview capability that helps identify data across the data estate.
Azure Policy: the behavior by which a policy assigned at a higher scope applies to resources in child scopes.
Policy definition: the ability of some policy configurations to automatically correct noncompliant resources.
Policy definition: an individual Azure Policy rule that describes a desired or prohibited resource condition.
Azure Policy: a service for creating, assigning, and managing rules that audit or control Azure resource configurations.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Azure Policy — a service for creating, assigning, and managing rules that audit or control Azure resource configurations; and Policy definition — an individual Azure Policy rule that describes a desired or prohibited resource condition.

questions.question: Which TWO statements accurately reflect the concepts covered in this unit?

options.text: Initiative: the ability of a policy to block creation of noncompliant resources.
Policy inheritance: a family of data governance, risk, and compliance solutions that provides a unified view of data across environments.
Policy inheritance: the behavior by which a policy assigned at a higher scope applies to resources in child scopes.
Initiative: a collection of related Azure Policy definitions grouped to support a broader compliance goal.
Policy inheritance: a Purview capability for identifying and classifying sensitive information.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Initiative — a collection of related Azure Policy definitions grouped to support a broader compliance goal; and Policy inheritance — the behavior by which a policy assigned at a higher scope applies to resources in child scopes.
